#219 correctness review, round 2: PASS

Head: 31bf8fb74039744fcdb4b28cb392ed9393184ff5.

F001 / P219-F001 is closed. Rust refreshes only key-file clients after connection refusal, shares the refreshed key with clones, and never replaces an explicit job token. Copilot reads its boot key again for each recovery attempt. Both allow one additional 401 attempt after recovery, with another key read, then return an ordinary repeated 401. A 401 without a preceding refusal is returned once. The daemon bearer middleware refuses unauthorized requests before next.run, so this additional attempt cannot replay an admitted handler. Body-read errors, resets and non-refusal transport errors remain outside the retry loop.

The replacement-server tests validate Authorization with genuinely different fixture keys and both publication orders. They cover the actual defect rather than only port recovery. No real credential file was read during review.

S219-N001 is closed for the requested daemon tool path: the OMP tool signal travels through RustSendOptions/SpawnOpts, runtime, client send/spawn and fetch; cancellation during sleep throws before another attempt. The client cancellation regression and runtime signal-identity regression are present. The new JS wall-clock checks stop adding pauses beyond the deadline without adding periodic activity. OMP's pre-existing authentication retry/second-wait limit is explicitly disclosed, not a new block.
